entities.summary: Vanchi LaShawn Jefferson Jr. is an American professional football wide receiver for the Washington Commanders of the National Football League (NFL). Jefferson played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels and Florida Gators and was selected by the Los Angeles Rams in the second round of the 2020 NFL draft, where he won Super Bowl LVI during the 2021 season. He has also played for the Atlanta Falcons, Pittsburgh Steelers, and Tennessee Titans.
